limitations.screenReaderOrKeyboardCompatibility: not-tested beyond the focused map key and its visible direction buttons

renderer.fallbackRule: Phaser.AUTO chooses WebGL when available and falls back to Canvas; the report records Phaser's actual renderer type.
renderer.diagnostics: window.__t07SpaceRender and the canvas host dataset are written only by Phaser POST_RENDER after its scene objects render.
